# <c-4dff60>P</c><c-4eff5c>r</c><c-4eff57>a</c><c-4ffe53>c</c><c-4ffe4f>t</c><c-50fe4b>i</c><c-50fe46>c</c><c-51fe42>e</c> <c-51fd3e>L</c><c-52fd39>o</c><c-52fd35>o</c><c-52fd35>p</c> <c-52fd39>R</c><c-51fd3e>a</c><c-51fe42>n</c><c-50fe46>d</c><c-50fe4b>o</c><c-4ffe4f>m</c><c-4ffe53>i</c><c-4eff57>z</c><c-4eff5c>e</c><c-4dff60>r</c>

The smaller sister mod to <c-f25d83>M</c><c-f35f81>e</c><c-f4627e>n</c><c-f6647c>u</c> <c-f7677a>L</c><c-f86977>o</c><c-fa6b75>o</c><c-fb6e72>p</c> <c-fc7070>Ra</c><c-fb6e72>n</c><c-fa6b75>d</c><c-f86977>o</c><c-f7677a>m</c><c-f6647c>i</c><c-f4627e>z</c><c-f35f81>e</c><c-f25d83>r</c> (<c-f25d83>M</c><c-fc7070>L</c><c-f25d83>R</c>). Shuffle random songs to loop in Practice Mode. For those who hate "Stay Inside Me", but can't afford to buy Music Customizers from Scratch the Shopkeeper.

<mod:elnexreal.menuloop_randomizer>

<c-ff0000>***__NOTE__***:</c> The "Practice Music Sync" takes priority over <c-4dff60>P</c><c-4eff5c>r</c><c-4eff57>a</c><c-4ffe53>c</c><c-4ffe4f>t</c><c-50fe4b>i</c><c-50fe46>c</c><c-51fe42>e</c> <c-51fd3e>L</c><c-52fd39>o</c><c-52fd35>o</c><c-52fd35>p</c> <c-52fd39>R</c><c-51fd3e>a</c><c-51fe42>n</c><c-50fe46>d</c><c-50fe4b>o</c><c-4ffe4f>m</c><c-4ffe53>i</c><c-4eff57>z</c><c-4eff5c>e</c><c-4dff60>r</c>.  

Controlling the music for Practice Mode is already quite tricky on its own. As such, below is an **anti-roadmap** (features that will ***never*** come, especially compared to <c-f25d83>M</c><c-fc7070>L</c><c-f25d83>R</c>) so this mod's codebase remains manageable while still offering (weaker variations of) features expected from <c-f25d83>M</c><c-fc7070>L</c><c-f25d83>R</c>.

## Anti-roadmap
- Any UI beyond the settings popup provided by Geode
- In-game UI to control practice loop playback (or playback progress)
- In-game UI to favorite/blacklist songs or add songs to playlists
- Real-time practice loop song swapping (including from song reloads)

This mod should be used as an add-on to <c-f25d83>M</c><c-fc7070>L</c><c-f25d83>R</c>; this mod's most important code comes from there. Playlists and song folders from <c-f25d83>M</c><c-fc7070>L</c><c-f25d83>R</c> will work with this mod. (Hooray for minimizing file duplication!)

This [Geode mod](https://geode-sdk.org) is licensed under LGPLv2. To report bugs or get help with using my mods, press the Discord button in the lower left corner.
